tool.name: run_gosec
tool.description:
Run gosec security scanner on Go module directories.
Runs `gosec -fmt json ./...` in each module directory. Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary — never returns raw gosec JSON to the agent.
modules_json must be a JSON array of module paths relative to repo_path.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root (returned by setup_repo).

parameter.name: modules_json
parameter.description: JSON array of module directory paths relative to repo_path. Example: '["api/", "workers/platform/", "workers/graph/"]'. Use '["./"]' for single-module repos.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, modules_scanned, modules_failed}. If not installed: {success: false, skipped: true, reason}.

tool.name: run_semgrep
tool.description:
Run semgrep SAST scanner on the repository.
Selects the appropriate ruleset based on language (p/golang or p/java). scan_paths_json restricts scanning to specific directories (default: entire repo). Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary — never returns raw semgrep JSON.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

parameter.name: language
parameter.description: "go" or "java" — selects semgrep ruleset (p/golang or p/java).

parameter.name: scan_paths_json
parameter.description: JSON array of paths relative to repo_path to scan. Default "." scans the entire repo. Example: '["api/", "workers/"]'.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, rules_matched, total_semgrep_results}. If not installed: {success: false, skipped: true, reason}.

tool.name: run_golangci_lint
tool.description:
Run golangci-lint code quality scanner on Go module directories.
Runs `golangci-lint run --out-format json ./...` per module. Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary — never returns raw linter JSON.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

parameter.name: modules_json
parameter.description: JSON array of module directory paths relative to repo_path. Example: '["api/", "workers/platform/"]'. Use '["./"]' for single-module repos.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, modules_scanned, modules_failed, linters_triggered}. If not installed: {success: false, skipped: true, reason}.

tool.name: run_checkstyle
tool.description:
Run Checkstyle style checker on Java source files.
Looks for 'checkstyle' on PATH or accepts an explicit JAR path. config: "google" (default) or "sun" — selects the bundled rule config. Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary — never returns raw XML.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root. Source files are expected under src/.

parameter.name: checkstyle_jar
parameter.description: Absolute path to the checkstyle JAR file. Leave empty to use 'checkstyle' from PATH.

parameter.name: config
parameter.description: "google" (default) or "sun" — selects the bundled Checkstyle configuration.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, files_checked}. If not found: {success: false, skipped: true, reason}.

tool.name: run_pmd
tool.description:
Run PMD static analysis on Java source files.
Looks for 'pmd' on PATH or accepts an explicit binary path. Uses the Java quickstart ruleset. Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary — never returns raw PMD JSON.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root. Source files are expected under src/.

parameter.name: pmd_bin
parameter.description: Absolute path to the PMD binary. Leave empty to use 'pmd' from PATH.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, rules_triggered}. If not found: {success: false, skipped: true, reason}.

tool.name: run_go_coverage
tool.description:
Run go test with coverage profiling on Go module directories.
Runs `go test -coverprofile=... ./...` then `go tool cover -func` per module. Records an INFO/LOW/HIGH finding per module based on coverage percentage. low_coverage_threshold: modules below this % get a finding (default 50).
Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary with per-module coverage percentages.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

parameter.name: modules_json
parameter.description: JSON array of module directory paths relative to repo_path. Example: '["api/", "workers/platform/"]'. Use '["./"]' for single-module repos.

parameter.name: low_coverage_threshold
parameter.description: Coverage percentage below which a finding is recorded (default 50). Modules at exactly 0% get a HIGH finding.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, modules_scanned, modules_failed, overall_avg_coverage_pct, module_totals: [{module, total_pct}]}.

tool.name: run_jacoco
tool.description:
Run JaCoCo test coverage for Java projects.
Runs `mvn test jacoco:report` (Maven) or `./gradlew test jacocoTestReport` (Gradle). Parses the JaCoCo XML report and records coverage findings per class. build_system: "maven", "gradle", or "auto" (detected from pom.xml/build.gradle).
Auto-records findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a clean summary with overall line coverage percentage.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

parameter.name: build_system
parameter.description: "maven", "gradle", or "auto" (default). Auto-detects from pom.xml or build.gradle presence.

parameter.name: low_coverage_threshold
parameter.description: Line coverage percentage below which a class finding is recorded (default 50).

tool.name: run_gitleaks
tool.description:
Run gitleaks to detect hardcoded secrets and credentials.
Scans the working tree and (by default) full git history. Secret values are NEVER stored in findings — only the rule ID, file, and line are recorded. Auto-records CRITICAL findings via create_code_finding internally. Returns a summary — never returns raw gitleaks JSON.

parameter.name: repo_path
parameter.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

parameter.name: scan_git_history
parameter.description: If true (default), scans full git commit history in addition to the working tree. Set to false for non-git directories.

returns.description: {success, findings_recorded, git_history_scanned}. If not installed: {success: false, skipped: true, reason}.
